name: Dudák
description: Dudák (Czech for 'Bagpiper') is a popular Czech shedding game closely related to the Russian game Durak. Played with a 32ndcard Germanndsuited deck, the game is a contest of attrition where players must defend against 'attacks' by beating cards with higher ranks or trumps. The goal is to empty one's hand; the last player left holding cards is the loser—the Dudák.

content.text: Dudák (Czech for 'Bagpiper') is a popular Czech shedding game closely related to the Russian game Durak. Played with a 32ndcard Germanndsuited deck, the game is a contest of attrition where players must defend against 'attacks' by beating cards with higher ranks or trumps. The goal is to empty one's hand; the last player left holding cards is the loser—the Dudák.
Dudák evolved as a regional variant of the Russian Durak, adapted for the 32ndcard deck prevalent in Bohemia and Moravia.
32ndcard Germanndsuited pack: Acorns (žaludy), Leaves (zelené), Hearts (červené), Balls (kule).
Usually 4nd6 cards to each player (common variation handles all 32 cards being dealt).

items.text: Open Dudák (Otevřený Dudák): Each player's trump suit is decided in advance and known to all; rules after trumps declared apply throughout.
Pocket Dudák (Kapsičkový Dudák): Each player is dealt a hand plus a face-down trump card; trumps are revealed when the player declares.
Secret Dudák (Tajný Dudák): Like Pocket Dudák except no one may see others' trump cards until the owner declares and turns the card face up.
Dudák with a Talon (Lízaný Dudák): Not all cards are dealt; remainder forms a talon. Players draw to replenish hand after play; when talon is empty, play continues as standard Dudák.
